title: InventorySwitch an RPG Maker MV & MZ Plugin

posts.author: CapLegHole
posts.body:
You ever wanted to have individual character inventories or you wanted to have a flashback scene and you didn't want your player able to access their original inventory? Well, I have the solution to the problem you have never had!
These plugins are free for use in anything. I would like credits in your game, but if you forget its okay. If you wanna send me a copy I would love to play it.
Lets get into the descriptions!
The MZ one I created first so its probably the most rough around the edges, but I might tweak it if I get feedback.
For MZ you define how many inventories you want with the first parameter. Default is 3... I think. It's been a long night. And then I did want to have friendly names, but at this point they are just leftover and if you fill out that parameter space its just a note of what each inventory is.
Then when you call it under the plugin command you can either switch to or display in a text box what is in each inventory by specifying what number inventory it is
No, I did not think about merging inventories until right now. XD
For MV, which I will create a post there as well and try to link it here and vise versa, the inventories are generated as you call switching to them for the first time. I would stick to numbering them because I had tons of issues on both when I used words.
Other than that, I've spent a ton of hours on these things because I'm not normally a plugin dev and I'm tired so I'm just rambling. Please enjoy and I hope someone gets use of them.
